subject: Goodness of fit assessment with insufficient degrees of freedom

messages.author: d48a75ab7113ac8e
messages.subject: Goodness of fit assessment with insufficient degrees of freedom
parts:
Hi List,

I'm analysizing ship-based seabird transect data where the distances were
collected in a small number of distance bins (4 or 5). With such a small
number of bins, there is often not enough degrees of freedom for a
Chi-square goodness of fit test on the "Detection Fct/Global/Chi-sq GOF
test" page of the results. I seem to remember being told at the DS course a
few years ago that, in such cases, a useful rule thumb for guidance is that
if the sum of the numbers in the "Chi-square values" column exceeds the
number of distance bins, then the fit is probably poor. Or was it that none
of the individual values should exceed 1?

Does this sound familiar to anyone - or did I make the whole thing up?

Thanks,
Dave
